# RSS Feeds for custom URLs and legacy usernames?
I'm trying to use the youtube RSS feature (`https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=`), and it works fine for channels whose URL ends with `/channel/CHANNEL_ID`, but it gives either a 404 or 400 error when I try the same with channels that end with `/user/CHANNEL_NAME` or `/c/CHANNEL_NAME`

results.description: Generate a YouTube channel RSS feed from a channel handle, URL, or ID. Copy the feed URL, preview the XML, and download it free online with no signup.
results.snippet:
# YouTube RSS Feed Generator
## What the YouTube RSS Feed Generator Creates
This tool does not host a separate custom feed. It identifies the channel ID and retrieves the public Atom XML feed provided by YouTube. People often call this an RSS feed because most modern feed readers support both RSS and Atom URLs.

The generated address follows this structure:

https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=CHANNEL_ID

YouTube uses the channel ID to identify the correct creator. This is helpful because a channel’s visible @handle can change, while its underlying UC channel ID usually remains the more dependable identifier

# YouTube RSS Feed: Find Any Channel Without a Tool (2026)
**Every public YouTube channel has a free RSS feed at https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=CHANNEL_ID. Replace CHANNEL_ID with the channel’s ID (a string starting with “UC”).
